title: Doubly Robust Estimation of Causal Effect on CVR with Targeted Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2608.13461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-click conversion rate (CVR) is a key metric in various scenarios including e-commerce and advertising, reflecting the efficiency and user experience in the second stage of the conversion process. Estimating the causal effect on CVR is therefore of great practical importance. However, directly applying existing causal inference methods to clicked samples introduces sample selection bias and increased variance due to the exclusion of non-click data. Recent studies on CVR prediction introduce "ideal loss", which optimizes model parameters using an unbiased estimate of the loss over the full sample. Nevertheless, there is no guarantee that unbiasedness of the loss implies unbiasedness of the final estimator.   We revisit this challenge from the perspective of semiparametric theory. translated_title: 针对CVR因果效应的双重稳健估计与目标正则化
translated_abstract: 点击后转化率（CVR）是电子商务和广告等多种场景中的关键指标，反映了转化过程第二阶段的效果和用户体验。因此，估计CVR的因果效应具有重要的实际意义。然而，直接将现有的因果推断方法应用于点击样本，会因排除非点击数据而产生样本选择偏差和方差增加。近期关于CVR预测的研究引入了“理想损失”，通过在全样本上使用损失的无偏估计来优化模型参数。尽管如此，损失的无偏性并不能保证最终估计量的无偏性。我们从半参数理论的角度重新审视这一挑战。具体而言，我们开发了一种新的针对链式结果（如CVR）的双重稳健因果效应估计器，并详细推导了其理论性质。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于半参数理论的新型双重稳健估计器，专门用于处理链式结果（如CVR）的因果效应，解决了样本选择偏差和方差问题，并提供了详细的理论性质推导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel doubly robust estimator based on semiparametric theory for causal effects on chain-structured outcomes like CVR, addressing sample selection bias and variance, with detailed theoretical properties derived.
